info.title: HostDealRadar public record lookup
info.description: Read-only lookup of public source records. It does not fetch third-party URLs, test checkout, or perform write operations.

get.summary: Look up public records by exact provider ID or record slug

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Exact provider ID or name; cannot be combined with slug.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Exact public record ID; cannot be combined with provider.

200.description: One or more bounded public records.
